title: Require Server Host Telemetry Context Authority
forbids: a second parser-visible AsyncLocalStorage constructor authority in server host source
why: The server host has one request-scoped logging context store. Keeping its construction in logging.ts preserves one host-owned correlation authority while OpenTelemetry remains the active-span authority.
remediate: Consume the host logging context authority from apps/server/src/logging.ts instead of constructing another AsyncLocalStorage in server source.
message: Server source may construct AsyncLocalStorage only as the canonical hostLoggingContext in logging.ts.
